description: This file defines a utility/helper class 'FinAccountHelper' in Java that provides methods for managing financial account operations, including generating unique account codes, retrieving account balances, and validating accounts within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: FinAccountHelper
classes.description: A final utility class containing static methods for handling financial account operations such as balance calculations, account code generation, validation, and other helper utilities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getDecimals
methods.description: Returns the number of decimal places used for financial calculations, based on configuration.

methods.name: getRounding
methods.description: Returns the RoundingMode used for financial calculations.

methods.name: getZero
methods.description: Returns a BigDecimal representing zero with the configured scale and rounding.

methods.name: getGiftCertFinAccountTypeId
methods.description: Returns the constant string identifier for gift certificate account type.

methods.name: addFirstEntryAmount
methods.description: Adds the amount from the first transaction in a list of transactions to an initial value, with proper scaling and rounding.

methods.name: getNewFinAccountCode
methods.description: Generates a unique, random account code consisting of uppercase letters and digits, ensuring it does not already exist in the 'FinAccount' entity.

methods.name: getFinAccountFromCode
methods.description: Retrieves a FinAccount record based on a given account code, normalizing and filtering the input for safety.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Calculates the current balance for a specified financial account by summing deposit and adjustment transactions minus withdrawals up to a specified date.

methods.name: getAvailableBalance
methods.description: Calculates the net available balance by subtracting authorized but unexpired amounts from the total account balance.

methods.name: validateFinAccount
methods.description: Stub method for validating a financial account; currently returns false.

methods.name: validatePin
methods.description: Validates a PIN number against the stored value for a given financial account.

methods.name: checkFinAccountNumber
methods.description: Validates a financial account number using the Luhn checksum algorithm.
